h: Farooq Oreagba, 'King of Steeze', reveals cancer relapse
p: Media personality Farooq Oreagba, known as the King of Steeze, says his multiple myeloma has returned. He first received a cancer diagnosis in 2014.
body: Nigerian media personality Farooq Oreagba, popularly known as Mr Steeze or the King of Steeze, has revealed that his cancer has returned.

In a video circulating online, Oreagba said routine checks earlier in 2026 showed worrying changes in some of his results. A later test showed a rise in a key marker for the disease, and a bone marrow biopsy confirmed in August that his multiple myeloma had returned.
Oreagba was first diagnosed with cancer in February 2014.
He also shared when he hopes to be free of the disease.
more: A biopsy confirmed the relapse in August.
